title: DTX Drum Flow RepairSpec V1
coordinateRule: All x/y/width/height values are integer pixels in the 1448x1086 source canvas. Unknown values MUST be null and paired with NEEDS_MEASUREMENT.
zeroDriftRule: Outside editable/exception ROI and for locked camera/stool/inactive body regions, permitted changed pixels and shifts are 0 unless an explicit measured exception ROI is approved.
promotionRule: Candidate-only until SHA identity, ROI, anchors, contacts, diff checks, fixed-drum composite, runtime repeat, neighbor regression, PC and Xperia evidence all pass.
